about_the_game:
This is a physics-based game that will test your piloting skills.

As the pilot of a spaceship equipped with two rockets, one on each side,

you must independently control both rockets to navigate treacherous courses and reach the summit.

  • Dual Rocket Control: Control the thrust of each rocket individually to balance your ship and perform daring acrobatic feats.

  • Unpredictable Challenges: Awaiting you are narrowing paths, moving platforms, and all sorts of obstacles trying to tip you over.

  • Immersive High-Stakes Gameplay: Easy to learn, but extremely difficult to master. A single minor mistake can turn everything to dust.

  • Two Challenge Modes: For a more relaxed experience, try 'Basic Mode' with intermittent save points. To test the very limits of your control, take on 'Master Mode,' where a single mistake is unforgivable.

  • Purely Skill-Based: Your delicate control and judgment are the only keys to the summit. Prove you are the best pilot!

  • Playtime: It is generally expected to take 2-3 hours, but depending on the circumstances, it could also take ∞ hours.
